# Archon Docs — llms-full.txt
# Full content summary for AI crawlers

## About Archon
Archon is an iOS app (SwiftUI, iOS 17+) that lets users build apps by describing them in natural language. An AI agent generates working code in real-time, which users can browse, edit, and preview live. Built with Supabase for backend, async/await for concurrency, and Keychain for secure session storage.

## Screens and Features

### Onboarding
4-page polished onboarding flow introducing the app. Uses brand colors (#7c5cfc purple accent) with animated page transitions.

### Authentication
Email + Apple Sign In. Sessions backed by iOS Keychain. Supabase Auth integration with token refresh.

### Dashboard
Project list/grid view with search, create, delete, pull-to-refresh, and empty states. Shows project name, description, creation date, and preview thumbnail.

### AI Builder
Streaming chat interface. User describes what they want, AI generates code step by step. Features: task timeline showing progress, retry/cancel, model selection (multiple LLM providers), credit system, conversation history.

### Code Browser
File tree sidebar + syntax-highlighted code editor. Supports Swift, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JSON. Based on UIKit UITextView with custom syntax highlighting.

### Live Preview
WKWebView rendering of generated HTML/CSS/JS apps. Real-time updates as code changes. Supports HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript.

### Settings
Account management, appearance (light/dark/system), API key configuration, about page, open-source licenses.

## Architecture
MVVM pattern. Views are SwiftUI. ViewModels are ObservableObject with @Published properties. Network layer uses APIClientProtocol with MockAPIClient for development and AuthenticatedAPIClient for production. Supabase handles auth and data persistence.

## Learning Center
Interactive coding lessons organized by language. Each lesson has:
- Explanatory content with code examples
- Live code editor with real-time output
- Multiple-choice quiz at the end
- Progress tracking (XP, streaks, badges)
- Gamification: 9 achievement badges, streak tracking, confetti animations

Languages covered: HTML (5 lessons), CSS (5), TypeScript (5), Python (5), Swift (5), Java (5). Total: 30 interactive lessons.

## Developer Documentation
- Architecture overview with MVVM diagrams
- API reference for all Codable models
- Navigation flow documentation
- Design system tokens and guidelines
- Setup guide with XcodeGen
- Testing with MockAPIClient
- TestFlight deployment guide
- Contributing guidelines

## Design System
Dark-mode-first with automatic light mode. Colors: #06060a (void), #0c0c14 (secondary), #7c5cfc (accent purple). Typography: Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for code. 44pt minimum touch targets. Dynamic Type support. VoiceOver labels on all interactive elements.
